items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: I know I've heard him on records With George

ctx.x: And certainly George was discouraged As he told Greenwood and he told Meaghan He was about ready to quit Things didn't help up

And thing And after that story came out Things picked up for them Almost immediately Yes And they went on a lot of They did a lot of traveling They went abroad a number of times They made an awfully large number of records And I'm sure they That their income increased appreciably What about Ken Howard? Did you ever hear him with George? I know I've heard him on records With George I don't remember offhand Ever hearing him with the band Did you hear him at all? I've heard him But I can't I can't quite be sure where
What about a place like Lutton's? Did you go there very often?
